descriptions.d19c_chute_start_800db014: On the first call (+76): an active object posts the target message for +164; otherwise, unless blocked (+68), set active and launching, call 0x800dc184, read "Gravity" x "Low.Gravity.Multiplier", "Wind.Direction" and "Wind.Speed", set the acceleration at +120 to (cos(direction) x speed, gravity, sin(direction) x speed) and, unless +160 is set, post the open message with value 42.
